Question: Let \(a\gt0,\) and let \(P(x)\) be a polynomial with integer coefficients such that \[ \begin{aligned} &P(1)=P(3)=P(5) \\ &\quad {}=P(7)=a, \end{aligned} \] and \[ \begin{aligned} &P(2)=P(4)=P(6) \\ &\quad {}=P(8)=-a. \end{aligned} \] What is the smallest possible value of \(a?\)
